name: Franciscan University of Steubenville
academic_ranking: Private, Catholic liberal arts university founded in 1946 by the Franciscan Friars of the Third Order Regular. Known nationally for its Catholic identity, theology and catechetics programs, and strong faith-centered campus culture. Offers a broad range of undergraduate majors with a liberal arts core.
financial_aid: Institutional and need-based aid available; as an NCAA Division III program, no athletic scholarships are awarded. Financial aid is limited to academic merit scholarships, need-based grants, and federal/state aid. Specific softball aid figures not publicly listed on athletics site (checked 2026-07).
facilities_notes: Softball played at the on-campus program under Franciscan Athletics. Specific facility name/details not confirmed from a live athletics page during this research (checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Presidents' Athletic Conference (PAC). Currently led by head coach Daniella Pillar (Franciscan '13), the program's eighth head coach, who was initially named interim head coach for 2023-24. Small roster (13 players for 2026 season).
notes: Athletics website is franciscanathletics.com (the discovery domain franciscanbarons.com refused connections and appears outdated/incorrect). Coaching staff and roster confirmed from live franciscanathletics.com softball pages on 2026-07. Tuition ~$34,100 reflects 2024-25 undergraduate tuition & fees per multiple public sources; verify current-year figure with the university.
